recipes.name: Sweet Potato Spiced Chili
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over high heat. Cook the onion until golden.
Then add the garlic and spices and cook while stirring for another 1 to 2 minutes more*.
Add a bit more oil followed by tomato paste. Cook to toast for 1 more minute, stirring throughout.
Deglaze the pot by adding in the crushed tomatoes, water, beans, lentils, crushed bouillon cubes, sweet potato, and bell pepper.
Bring everything to a boil, reduce to a simmer, and cook partially covered for 30 minutes. Stir every 5 to 10 minutes.
If a thicker consistency is desired, remove the lid and cook uncovered for several more minutes. Stir in the corn in the last few minutes before serving.
Serve, add your desired toppings, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † We use pure ground chili powder made from dried chili peppers - not to be confused with the chili powder spice blend commonly found in the US, which often includes cumin, garlic powder, and other seasonings. For the intended heat and flavour, be sure to use pure chili powder. * This chili is spicy. Consider using a mild chili powder, or add less chili powder to start if you're spice adverse (especially if living in Europe where chili powders tend to be spicier). You can always taste test and add more later.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days. Portion out and keep in the freezer for up to 2 months.
